title: Building from the ground up: augmentation strategies to improve protein language model performance on protein sets
authors: Emily Stump; Hayden Dennison; Pietro Strobbia; George Stan; Ruxandra I. Dima
one_liner_zh: 该文研究在有限数据集下通过数据增强策略提升蛋白质语言模型在蛋白质复合物集合上的预测性能，涉及蛋白质结构相关计算但方法创新有限。
abstract: An important underlying requirement for deep learning models is the availability of large datasets, however, in sciences such as chemistry and biology, generating experimental data of sufficient size represents a significant bottleneck. In this work, we probed the extent and nature of limited input data, characterize how several protein language models (pLMs) learned on suboptimal datasets, and investigated augmentation approaches to improve predictive model performance. We found that narrowing the distribution of protein-protein complexes in a limited dataset permits an order-ofmagnitude decrease in training dataset size, if a model is only expected to generalize to in-distribution data. Similar results were found in active learning (AL), where both inand out-of-distribution Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) showed a small but consistent increase upon augmentation of the training set with complexes produced by ESM-3, a generative pLM.
abstract_zh: 深度学习模型的一个重要基础要求是具备大规模数据集的可用性，然而，在化学和生物学等科学领域，生成足够规模的实验数据构成了一个显著的瓶颈。在本研究中，我们探讨了有限输入数据的程度和性质，刻画了几种蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）在次优数据集上的学习方式，并研究了增强方法以提升预测模型的性能。我们发现，在有限数据集中缩小蛋白质-蛋白质复合物的分布范围，可以使训练数据集的大小降低一个数量级，前提是模型仅需泛化到分布内数据。在主动学习（active learning, AL）中也观察到了类似结果，其中分布内和分布外的马修斯相关系数（Matthews Correlation Coefficient, MCC）在通过生成式pLM ESM-3产生的复合物增强训练集后，均显示出小幅但一致的提升。
